nodes.name: Daily 02:00 UTC
nodes.notes: n8n is only a scheduler here. All fetch-and-parse logic lives in the API's tested ingestion module (apps/api/src/ingest), so it can be unit-tested — n8n Code nodes cannot.

nodes.name: Run all sources
nodes.notes: 600s timeout: GDELT paces at one country every 6s (~3 min), and the API scores the whole cohort before responding. neverError so a 207 partial-success (some source down, e.g. ReliefWeb before its appname is approved) is inspected below rather than throwing.

nodes.name: Generate and deliver top brief
nodes.notes: Generates one grounded brief for the highest-ranked crisis. Groq is optional: the API uses a deterministic template when no key is configured. Telegram/email are attempted only when their credentials exist.
